description: Brandriskanalyser per dygn och timme - API is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by smhi.se. Through these services, fire risk analyses for the current season are obtained per day and hour in real time. The API for days represents the fire risk in the afternoon when the fire risk is usually at its highest. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Daily and hourly fire risk analyses - API" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
